title: Entrainment-Mediated Tropical-Cyclone Intensification
exact_target: Test the proposed cloud-entrainment pathway to cyclone intensification using high-resolution three-dimensional simulations.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005987 (OWR-14298586-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Model Hierarchies in Atmosphere, Ocean, and Climate Sciences (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/31, pp. 1731--1786. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The source requests physical-model validation, not a proof for an unspecified universal PDE. The asymptotic pathway and simulated observables must be compared in the source regime.
